TERMS OF USE
DEFINITIONS
“We”, “FB Network”, “Face Wash Fox”: FB NETWORK JOINT STOCK COMPANY.
“Customer”, “You”: An individual aged 16 or above, or an organization, using the services of Face Wash Fox.
“Services”: All beauty services, skincare services, treatment packages and other amenities provided by Face Wash Fox.

“Foxie Membership Card” / “Foxie Card”: A membership card issued by Face Wash Fox in the form of an electronic account, comprising various membership packages with differing benefits and policies (such policies may change in accordance with programs introduced by Face Wash Fox’s sales and operations departments from time to time). The card purchase amount is converted directly into “Foxie Point” (service entitlement) for payment of Face Wash Fox services. The Foxie Card is not a form of prepaid top-up, is non-refundable and non-cancellable (except as provided in Section A.III.3), and does not constitute a repayable debt of Face Wash Fox.

“Foxie Point”: The unit representing the service entitlement attached to a Foxie Membership Card, converted from the amount paid by the customer when purchasing a Foxie Membership Card (e.g. VND 1,000,000 = 1,000,000 Foxie Point), and used to pay for beauty, skincare and treatment services within the Face Wash Fox System. “Foxie Star Program”: The Foxie Star loyalty and rewards program, under which customers earn Stars on their spending and redeem Stars for rewards. The program is available to Foxie Star Members and is governed by Section A.IV.

“Foxie Star Member”: A customer who has registered a Face Wash Fox account with a valid phone number to participate in the Foxie Star Program, regardless of whether they have purchased a Foxie Membership Card.

“Foxie Star” / “Star”: A reward point recording the customer’s Actual Payment Value under the Foxie Star Program, redeemable only for rewards in the Reward Catalog/Vouchers. Stars are not money, are not Foxie Point and have no cash redemption value.

“Actual Payment Value”: The amount paid by the customer in cash, by bank card, bank transfer or e-wallet, after deduction of all discounts and vouchers; excluding any portion of services paid with Foxie Point.
“Reward Catalog”: The list of services, products and vouchers redeemable with Stars, as displayed in the Face Wash Fox application.
“Star Redemption”: The use of Stars to receive rewards from the Reward Catalog or as a direct deduction from an invoice.

FOXIE STAR LOYALTY AND REWARDS PROGRAM

The Foxie Star Loyalty and Rewards Program (hereinafter the “Foxie Star Program” or the “Program”) is a program implemented by Face Wash Fox under which customers receive 01 Star for every VND 10,000 of Actual Payment Value within the Face Wash Fox System and may redeem Stars for rewards in accordance with the terms of this Section. In this Section, “member” means a Foxie Star Member.

Matters not governed by this Section shall be subject to the general provisions of these Terms of Use. In the event of any inconsistency between this Section and the general provisions, this Section shall prevail with respect to the Foxie Star Program.
Eligibility and scope
Eligible participants: Members must be individuals registered with an active phone number in Vietnam that is registered in their own name. Each phone number may register only 01 (one) account.
Age: Members must be aged 16 or above. Face Wash Fox reserves the right to request age verification where necessary.
Scope: The Program applies at all stores within the Face Wash Fox System nationwide and on official online channels, except for stores or periods separately announced by Face Wash Fox.
Exclusions: Corporate customers, wholesale orders, B2B contracts or transactions via third-party partners (e-commerce platforms, agents), unless otherwise announced by Face Wash Fox.
Face Wash Fox employees: participate under a separate internal welfare policy and may not use their member accounts to earn Stars on behalf of customers.
Star earning mechanism
Every VND 10,000 of Actual Payment Value = 01 Star, rounded down per invoice. Example: an invoice of VND 289,000 earns 28 Stars; the remaining VND 9,000 is not carried over to subsequent invoices.
Transactions eligible for Stars:
Single face-wash and skincare services at stores;
Treatment packages/Foxie Membership Cards: Stars are earned once based on the payment value at the time of package purchase;
Retail products at stores and on official online channels.
Transactions not eligible for Stars:
The portion of payment made with vouchers, gifts or gift cards issued by Face Wash Fox;
Service sessions used from prepaid treatment packages (Stars already earned upon package purchase);
Services paid with Foxie Point;
Services and rewards obtained through Star Redemption.
Crediting of Stars:

Stars are automatically credited to the member’s account by the system as soon as the invoice is paid. The invoice must be linked to the member’s phone number or member ID in the application before payment.
The Star crediting date is the invoice payment date. The number of Stars shown in the application may be delayed by up to 24 hours due to system synchronization.

Paid invoices not linked to a phone number/member ID will not earn Stars. Face Wash Fox does not retroactively credit Stars for invoices after payment, even if the member presents the invoice or receipt or contacts the Customer Care department.
Face Wash Fox may apply Star multipliers (x2, x3, etc.) during promotional programs; specific conditions will be set out in each announcement.
Use and redemption of Stars
Members may redeem Stars for rewards in the Reward Catalog/Vouchers in accordance with the following rules:

General rules:
Stars cannot be converted into cash, and no change is refunded where the value of Stars exceeds the amount payable.
Star Redemption is performed directly by the customer in the Face Wash Fox application.
Stars may not be used to pay for treatment packages, Foxie Membership Cards, prepaid cards or gift cards; Stars are not deducted for any portion of services paid with Foxie Point.

Rewards in the Reward Catalog are available in limited quantities; when a reward is out of stock, Face Wash Fox reserves the right to discontinue it or replace it with a reward of equivalent value and update the application accordingly. Any change to the number of Stars required for a reward or to the Star deduction rate shall be made in accordance with Section A.IV.7 (Amendment and Termination).

Vouchers redeemed with Stars are valid until the expiry date stated on the voucher; expired vouchers cannot be extended and Stars will not be refunded. Other voucher conditions are governed by Section A.III.4 (Conditions of Use of Vouchers).
A Star Redemption transaction that has been successfully confirmed cannot be cancelled, except as provided in Section A.IV.5.
Validity of Stars
Each batch of Stars is valid for 12 (twelve) months from the date of crediting, calculated on a rolling basis per invoice. Example: Stars earned on 15/03/2027 expire at 23:59 on 14/03/2028.
Expired Stars are automatically cancelled and cannot be extended or reinstated.
Customers are responsible for monitoring their Stars via the application. Failure to receive a notification does not alter the validity period of Stars.

Should Face Wash Fox terminate the Program, members will be given at least 30 (thirty) days’ prior notice to use their remaining Stars; vouchers redeemed before the termination date remain valid until the expiry date stated on the voucher.
Refunds, service cancellations and Star adjustments

When an invoice is refunded or cancelled, Stars are recalculated as if the refunded portion of the transaction had never occurred. If the Star balance is insufficient for recovery, the shortfall is converted at the Star earning rate in Section A.IV.2 (01 Star equivalent to VND 10,000) and deducted from the refund amount.

Accounts, transfer and handling of violations

Stars are linked to the individual account and are non-transferable, not for sale and may not be combined across accounts, including where the member is a Foxie Membership Cardholder who shares Foxie Point with others.
Accounts:

Members are responsible for safeguarding their login credentials and login devices. Face Wash Fox is not responsible for Stars used as a result of the member disclosing their login credentials, except where caused by a system error or security breach on the part of Face Wash Fox.
Change of phone number: the member must contact the Customer Care department for ownership verification; Stars will be transferred to the new number and the old account will be closed.

Members have the right to request account deletion; all remaining Stars will be cancelled at the time of deletion. Face Wash Fox will notify the member of the remaining Stars before proceeding with deletion.
Conduct deemed fraudulent:
Earning Stars on behalf of others or using one’s own phone number for another person’s invoice for profit;
Creating multiple accounts or using virtual phone numbers/numbers not registered in one’s own name;
Exploiting system errors or colluding with staff to credit or redeem Stars in breach of the rules;
Buying, selling or exchanging Stars or vouchers redeemed with Stars.
Remedial measures:

Depending on the severity of the violation, Face Wash Fox may apply one or more of the following measures: recovery of Stars and redeemed rewards, temporary or permanent suspension of the account, a demand for reimbursement of the value used, or referral of the case to the competent authorities. Before permanently suspending an account, recovering rewards or demanding reimbursement, Face Wash Fox will notify the member and allow the member to provide an explanation within 07 (seven) days; during verification, Face Wash Fox may temporarily suspend the account. Employees who commit violations will be subject to disciplinary action in accordance with Face Wash Fox’s Labor Regulations.
